name: Xocolatl AccountLiquidator trusts a caller-supplied HouseOfReserve
summary: AccountLiquidator.liquidateUser() takes the HouseOfReserve from the caller and reads its token ids and price from it, while the liquidator holds LIQUIDATOR_ROLE on the AssetsAccountant. The attacker passed fake reserves that reused the real cbETH and WETH reserves' accounting token ids and returned a price that rounded the liquidation cost to zero, moved users' collateral balances to itself and withdrew 3.25 cbETH and 0.22 WETH from the real reserves; it and copycats then drained the Base and Polygon deployments' remaining reserves.
notes: Reset: the proxy has run 0xeab948ec since its creation (block 15586866); the AssetsAccountant granted it LIQUIDATOR_ROLE four blocks later, which the seizure needed. The proxy's only Liquidation events are the three campaign transactions.

Campaign: every Liquidation event of the Base and Polygon v2 liquidators that moved reserve assets without paying XOC. On Base a copycat took the reserves' remaining 0.0127 cbETH and 0.0008 WETH one block later; 0xfa0c1985 cleared its own debt with 32 fake-reserve liquidations after minting 153,061 XOC on flash-borrowed WETH and sold the XOC for 18.46 USDC, its realised value (rule 12). On Polygon (0xf183665d) 0x10cff32d and the Base attacker took 1,020 WPOL nine minutes after the anchor and 0xfc3facd6 the leftovers in August. Polygon liquidations that burned XOC (0xa3d5612d and others) and 0x998ca9ce's transferless calls are excluded.
